description: Search the agent's long-term memory for relevant context. Uses semantic search (meaning-based, not keyword). Returns the most relevant memories matching your query. Use this before making decisions to check for past context, user preferences, or prior conversations.

limit.description: Max number of memories to return (default 10)

query.description: Natural language query to search memories (e.g. "What does the user prefer for notifications?", "Previous swap transactions")

name: retrieve_memory
